# MyAnmol (Anmol Share Broking Pvt. Ltd.)

> Goal-based financial planning, mutual fund and SIF distribution, insurance solicitation, and PMS distribution for Indian families and NRIs.

## Regulatory identity

- Legal entity: Anmol Share Broking Private Limited
- Brand: MyAnmol
- AMFI registration number (ARN): 114893
- Initial AMFI registration: 16 Sep 2016
- Current ARN validity: 15 Sep 2028
- AMFI registrations: Mutual Fund Distributor and SIF Distributor
- APMI PMS distributor registration: APRN01456
- Email: mutualfunds@myanmol.com
- Corporate office: 4th Floor, No. 39/1, 33rd Cross Road, Jayanagar 4th T Block, Above Iyengar Bakery, Bangalore 560041
- Registered office: #23, 31 Main, J P Nagar 6 Phase, Behind Inchara Hotel, Bangalore 560078

## What the firm offers

- Savings, insurance and mutual fund investments planned around a household's goals.
- SIPs can start from ₹500 a month.
- Portfolio Management Services (PMS) distribution. SEBI minimum investment stated on the PMS page: ₹50 lakh.
- Specialised Investment Funds (SIF), alternative investment funds, and GIFT City access.
- Guidance for families, NRIs, doctors, women, teachers, armed forces, business owners, and Gen Z.
- The consultation described on the site is free and has no obligation.
